newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel barge premiums slip, demand slack.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel barge premiums slip, demand slack.

text.p: Demand for NWE jet fuel barges evaporated on Monday and premiums sagged below Feb +$30, traders said.
February IPE gas oil futures ended down $7.25 at $219 a tonne as NYMEX crude and products threw off earlier gains. Milder European weather also accelerated the fall.

Traders assessed barges around February +$28/29, down $3, with no inquiries and a small amount of offers. Cargo markets were quiet with traders seeking to meet smaller requirements. Premiums were notionally around Feb IPE +30/31 cif NWE.
